key_points: Q3 revenue up 17% YoY, beating guidance; full-year revenue outlook raised to $8.36‑$8.375B.
Operating margin improved to ~27%; demand strength in construction and emerging markets cited.
Share price fell 3.8% after earnings due to slower billings growth and AI monetisation concerns.
Analyst price targets mixed, with several cuts but multiple buy/outperform ratings maintained.
Retail sentiment turned extremely bullish while broader tech selloff persists.
